protocol.objective: Replace heads-up opponent-pool averages with six policies playing simultaneously at one table.
protocol.scoring: Actual payouts on elimination; larger stack at start of same hand takes higher rank; equal starting stacks split tied payouts. Exact recursive ICM on positive stacks distributes remaining top payouts at cutoff.
protocol.rules_engine: PokerKit 0.7.7; independent eval7 side-pot validation over 200 all-in deals with 2-6 players.
protocol.adapter: Original public bot interface. No-raise-rights signaled by min_raise_to=0 and can_raise=false; an unavailable requested raise maps to check/call. Raise totals are clamped to PokerKit legal bounds. All normalization counts recorded. No opponent private cards exposed.

confirmation.sampling: Random roster for every independent seed; six cyclic seat rotations with the same per-hand deck seeds; block mean is the statistical unit.

protocol.latency: Separate 30000 complete decision calls per bot on 10000 legal six-seat states, balanced by street, 5-200BB stacks; single EPYC7B12 core, warm models, GC disabled; no JSON or IPC.

strategy_modifications.cfr_lite64: Original rules and action sizing, 64 Monte Carlo rollouts each postflop street instead of original configured counts. Changes stochastic approximation, not a strategy-equivalence claim.
strategy_modifications.hydra32: Original adaptive_hydra, max_iters=32 instead of 300 in _mc_equity; no other strategic changes.
strategy_modifications.fullhouse: Previously validated FP32 ONNX export, original released weights.

protocol.validation: 7 tests passed: 200 independent side-pot settlements, all 2-6 player dealer/actor mappings, hidden-card boundaries, non-reopening short raises, simultaneous eliminations, exhaustive-permutation ICM reference, and six-seat identical-policy mirror control.

audit: All raw match totals and block means checked; every surviving-player ICM score independently recomputed by enumerating all finish permutations.
limitations: Custom six-place payout table, not the official unpublished payout table.
Only six-seat support is established; Fullhouse is a six-max model, not an eight-player model.
Warm single-core CPU latency, no process startup, JSON or IPC; P99 is not a hard worst-case guarantee.
Strength matches have no time penalties. Policy versions and weights unchanged from the low-latency comparison.
PokerKit adapter corrects unavailable requested actions consistently for every policy; counts are reported.
All ranked policies derive from the same public repository. Scores depend on this lineup and payout table.
